narr: A slow-moving cold front interacted with a warm and moist environment to trigger clusters of thunderstorms across north-central Illinois during the late afternoon and evening of June 6th. Some of the storms produced rainfall of 1 to 3 inches in a short period of time, leading to localized flash flooding. The flooding was primarily focused along and north of an Abingdon to Lacon line.
ev: Water was flowing across the roadway at the intersection of Illinois 17 and Illinois 40 just west of Camp Grove.
lsr: WATER OVER ROADWAY AT INTERSECTION OF IL 17/IL 40 WEST OF CAMP GROVE.
